HOW TO ORDER

From craving to cookie box, step by step.

Place your order online in a few minutes, then pay through Venmo or Cash App using your order number. Please allow one week’s notice for every order.

  1. STEP 01

    Browse the menu

    Four signature favorites plus two seasonal flavors that change every month.

    View the menu

  2. STEP 02

    Build your box

    Choose 4, 6, 12, 24 or 36 cookies and mix any flavors you like. The minimum order is 4 cookies.

    Build your box

  3. STEP 03

    Pick your pickup

    Choose a date at least one week away and a time between 10am and 7pm (Eastern). Pickup only, in Tyngsboro, MA.

  4. STEP 04

    Place your order

    Add your details and place your order. You’ll get an order number and payment details on screen and by email.

    Order now

  5. STEP 05

    Pay with Venmo or Cash App

    Send the total to @Palosha-Rashid on Venmo or $Pashabakess on Cash App, with your order number in the payment note.

  6. STEP 06

    Get your confirmation

    Once your payment arrives, Pasha emails your confirmation with the pickup address. Then just pick up and enjoy!

A FEW SWEET DETAILS

Good to know
before you order.

Storage tips, payments and the cancellation and refund policy are all on the FAQ page.

See all FAQs
How far ahead should I order?

Please give Pasha one week’s notice. Every cookie is made to order, so a little planning helps make your box extra special. Need cookies sooner? Email pashabakess@gmail.com and Pasha will let you know what’s possible.

Where do I pick up my cookies?

Pickup only in Tyngsboro, MA, normally between 10am and 7pm (Eastern time). You choose your pickup time when you order. The exact address is included in your confirmation email once your payment arrives. Delivery and shipping are not offered.

Can I mix and match the flavors?

Yes! Choose any mix from the current menu. Boxes are available as 4 cookies for $14, 6 for $20, 12 for $38, 24 for $76, or 36 for $114. The minimum order is 4 cookies. For orders above 3 dozen (36 cookies), email Pasha to arrange whole dozens and confirm pricing.

Are the cookies suitable for food allergies?

Pashabakess is not allergen-free. The cookies are not free of peanuts, tree nuts, gluten, dairy/eggs, soy, or food coloring, so they are not suitable for peanut, tree nut, gluten, dairy/egg, soy, or food coloring allergies. Everything is prepared in the same kitchen using shared equipment, trays, utensils, and packaging areas. Because cross-contact can happen, Pasha does not recommend ordering or sharing the cookies with anyone who has food allergies.

Are your ingredients halal?

Yes. All ingredients used in Pashabakess cookies are halal, including items such as marshmallows. If you have a question about a specific ingredient, please email Pasha before ordering.
